adjudication_records.issue_text: RunCommands is unimplemented, causing TablesList in pkg/expr/sql/parser.go to always fail

adjudication.rationale: The diff shows that in pkg/expr/sql/db.go, the RunCommands method is implemented as a stub that always returns an error ('not implemented'). In pkg/expr/sql/parser.go, the TablesList function creates a NewInMemoryDB() and calls duckDB.RunCommands(). Since RunCommands always returns an error, TablesList will always fail. This is a real defect - the code path from TablesList -> RunCommands will never succeed because the underlying implementation is a stub.
